messages:
luca_newhire: hey team — a few onboarding/payroll/benefits quick ones from week 1: 1) My Rippling invite shows "pending" for direct deposit — is there a cutoff I missed? 2) Does commuter pre-tax need separate enrollment or is it part of benefits elections? 3) I rented a monitor for a day ($30) while waiting for equipment  can that be reimbursed? 4) PTO accrual: do I get any accrual the first partial pay period?

sophie (People Ops): welcome, Luca! :wave: Short answers: 1) Direct deposit must be set before payroll cutoff to hit the run; upload bank routing/account in Rippling ASAP. 2) Commuter is a separate pre-tax election in Rippling (Benefits > Commuter) and has its own cutoff. 3) One-day monitor rental is expensable under "Onboarding - Home Office"; reimburse via Ramp or the expense form. 4) PTO is prorated; you should see it in Rippling within one pay cycle. Details below.

luca_newhire: my start date was 2026-11-10  which payroll run will be my first, and what's the cutoff for direct deposit to be active?

mike_payroll: Payroll is semi-monthly: 15th and last day. With 11/10 start, your first pay is 11/30 and will include prorated earnings for 11/10-11/30. Direct deposit setup needs to be completed before the payroll cutoff (usually the 10th of the month for month-end run). Since your bank info is pending, upload it and tag @mike_payroll in Rippling so we can confirm before cutoff. If it misses this cutoff, your pay will still be issued but as a paper check or early electronic after bank processing.

luca_newhire: commuter: i'm trying to start deductions for transit next pay  how fast can that be enabled?

sophie (People Ops): Commuter enrollments must be set before the payroll cutoff as well. Steps: Rippling > Benefits > Commuter > Enroll > choose pre-tax monthly amount. After you enroll, email payroll to confirm it will be applied for the next run. If you enroll after cutoff, it starts the following run.

alec_finance: Quick on the rental monitor: submit a Ramp expense or use form if you don't have Ramp yet. Category: "Onboarding - Home Office". Attach receipt and include a note explaining it's a temporary rental pending company equipment delivery. Example memo we accept:

```
Expense: Temporary monitor rental
Amount: $30.00
Date: 2026-11-11
Receipt: attached_photo.jpg
Category: Onboarding - Home Office
Notes: One-day rental while awaiting company laptop docking setup
```

alec_finance: Reimbursements are typically approved in ~3 business days and paid on the next payroll run unless marked urgent. If you need the cash sooner, mark "urgent-offcycle" in the Ramp note and tag @alec_finance.

luca_newhire: PTO question: since i started 11/10 do i accrue for the 11/1-11/15 period at all? Or only starting 11/16?

sophie (People Ops): PTO accrual is prorated by days worked in the pay period. For semi-monthly accrual, you'll see a portion for the 11/10-11/15 slice posted on the 11/15 run only if your hire date is before that payroll cutoff. In practice, Rippling will show the prorated balance in one pay cycle; if you don't see it after two cycles DM me and i'll trigger a manual adjustment.

hr-bot: Automated reminder: New hire benefits enrollment  complete elections in Rippling by 2026-11-24 to avoid default plan assignment.

luca_newhire: one more  bank had a holiday in my state so i'm worried direct deposit will bounce — do you notify people if there's a hold?

mike_payroll: Bank holidays can delay posting by one business day. If direct deposit fails due to incorrect routing/account info, payroll will notify you and issue payment as a paper check or off-cycle electronic. To avoid delays, confirm routing/account and upload a voided check or bank verification doc in Rippling. If you prefer, we can hold the first run and issue off-cycle direct deposit once verified; tag payroll in Rippling and we can coordinate.

luca_newhire: thanks everyone. i'll finish Rippling bank info now and submit the rental receipt. tagging @sophie if the commuter enrollment needs manual confirmation. :pray:
